document.title: Golden screenshots of every demo section; fix raw text leak
document.summary: The smoke harness screenshots all twelve demo sections and the Deck App Failure Screen instead of the single smoke Deck App screen, and the smoke example is deleted. Separately, `src/jslib/instance.c` frees raw text React deletes and keeps parent/child links consistent, a leak the new test surfaced under ASan.
document.why: The demo Deck App is [more comprehensive than the smoke app](source:s1), so the goldens should cover all of its pages, and the smoke app is no longer needed.

parts.name: Demo goldens
parts.summary: The smoke test drives the demo Deck App through every section and compares 13 Linux goldens.

parts.name: Raw text leak
parts.summary: Native instance bookkeeping frees deleted raw text and never leaves duplicate or dangling child links.

groups.title: Harness steps through the demo
groups.why: The goldens should cover [every demo page](source:s1).
groups.summary: `run_smoke_test.sh` installs the demo with `demo_stubs.js` prepended to `app.js`, and `smoke_harness.c` presses R per `PAGES` entry, then D-pad right twice and Cross to hit "Throw an error", comparing each frame against `tests/fixtures/golden/Linux/`.
lookFor: Subtle: `PAGES` in `tests/smoke_harness.c` hardcodes the demo's "N/12 · name" headers, so adding, renaming or reordering a demo section times out the harness until `PAGES` and the goldens are updated.
Subtle: `13-failure-screen.png` paints the stack trace with `app.js` and `runtime.js` line:column positions, so most demo or runtime JS edits also change that golden.
The old harness asserted `SMOKE_OK` (an interval ticked) and minimum node counts per type; the new harness drops both and relies on pixels, and `demo_stubs.js` freezes the Timers clock.
`VITADECK_DATA_ROOT` is now the relative `smoke-fixture`, so the Failure Screen path is identical in `out-smoke` and `out-sanitize`.

groups.title: Delete the smoke example
groups.why: The smoke app [is no longer needed](source:s1) once the demo is the fixture.
groups.summary: The `smoke` example is deleted and its DejaVu Sans Mono moves into `demo/assets/fonts`, replacing the demo's symlinks into it.

groups.title: Docs point at the new goldens
groups.why: `AGENTS.md` asks to fix docs and skills in place when a change makes them inaccurate.
groups.summary: ADR 0002, `AGENTS.md` and the `vitadeck-smoke` skill now name `tests/fixtures/golden/Linux/` and the demo instead of `smoke_golden.Linux.png` and the smoke app; wording only.

groups.title: Free deleted raw text; consistent child links
groups.why: The sanitized smoke run on the demo reported raw text leaks, then a use-after-free once raw text was freed; the user asked to [commit the fix too](source:s1).
groups.summary: `unlink_child` runs before every append, insert, remove and destroy, so `native_destroy_instance` can safely free its raw text children and clear its other children's `parent`.
lookFor: Production code in a test PR: every raw text node React deleted used to stay allocated and registered, on the Vita too; it is now freed in `native_remove_child` or when its parent is destroyed.
Behavior change: appending or inserting an already attached child now moves it, where before it stayed at its old index too and was listed twice.
Subtle: `native_remove_child` ignores its `parentId` argument and unlinks from `child->parent`, or the root when `parent` is NULL.

commits.subject: test(smoke): screenshot every demo section instead of the smoke Deck App
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
The smoke harness now boots the demo Deck App, presses R through all twelve sections, then presses "Throw an error", comparing each page against tests/fixtures/golden/Linux/. tests/fixtures/demo_stubs.js is prepended to the test copy of the bundle to pin Date, getTime() and fetch. The smoke example is deleted; its DejaVu Sans Mono moves into the demo.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: fix(jslib): free deleted raw text and keep child links consistent
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
React calls detachDeletedInstance only for host components, so every raw text node it deleted stayed allocated and registered. Raw text is now freed when React removes it directly or when its parent is destroyed.

Appending or inserting an already attached child (React's move) left it listed twice, and destroying an instance left stale pointers in its parent's children. Every link change now unlinks the child first, and destroying an instance detaches it from its parent and clears its children's parent.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
